card.name: End of CYP3A4 and similar terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a technical term just before a linking word or bracket, mostly the 4 in CYP3A4 and the F in LVEF. It also fires on the end of a few other medical words.

modes.label: CYP3A4 final digit
modes.description: The digit 4 closing CYP3A4 before inhibitors, or, or a bracket.

modes.label: Other term endings
modes.description: The final letter or piece of an abbreviation or medical word, such as LVEF or uveitis.
